integrity: A self-contained exact proof and standalone finite-check program are included; numerical checks are supplementary and independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Radial rank theorem assumes strictly positive strictly decreasing symmetric windows on even cyclic groups.
Volume optimizer only established for the geodesic exponential family, not every radial profile.
No assertion that determinant optimality implies smallest-eigenvalue optimality.
Older equivalent polyphase sampling treatments remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Parity rigidity and volume-optimal placement for radial cyclic Gabor bases
